subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` reject every changed text-model reference that the current configured catalogs cannot resolve, even when existing scripts previously persisted such a value for later runtime resolution?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent and proven, but choosing fail-closed write-time validation changes upgrade behavior for existing CLI and provider-auth workflows; that compatibility policy cannot be determined from tests alone.

options.title: Accept pre-write validation
options.body: Merge the PR and make catalog-resolvable changed text-model references a required condition for successful config writes.

options.title: Preserve permissive writes
options.body: Pause the PR and require an explicit strict mode or another compatibility design if maintainers want existing automation to keep accepting unresolved references.

recommendation.title: Accept pre-write validation
recommendation.body: Merge the PR and make catalog-resolvable changed text-model references a required condition for successful config writes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available human review context specifically identifies this as a maintainer compatibility decision.
